title: Rick tp gun hub
features: This code is open to everyone; you can use the necessary scripts in the code, and please subscribe. I put a lot of effort into this, and most of the GUI design, etc., was helped by AI. Apart from that, it's pure engineering, and I coded the green laser gun myself. I should mention that this script is universal, and the best-compatible game is the baseplate. If the floor and the portal in travel mode don't load, the model hasn't loaded, and you'll need to exit and re-enter the game and wait
script:
-- Rick Portal Gun + Combat v2.1
local success, err = pcall(function()
    loadstring(game:HttpGet("https://pastebin.com/raw/t9CP7JtZ", true))()
end)

if not success then
    warn("Script yükleme hatası: " .. tostring(err))
end
